title: qa/issues.webhigh.jsonl line 2 is not valid JSON (bad escape `\ ` at col 671, in a description of a character set `<>(),;:\"\ `); any reader that JSON.parses every ledger line throws
evidence: node: JSON.parse(line 2 of qa/issues.webhigh.jsonl) -> SyntaxError: Bad escaped character in JSON at position 670. It broke packages/index speaker-name-rules.test.ts 'D-015 ... byte-faithful' on main AND on GitHub CI run 38369705993 (ubuntu). Not CRLF/platform related: it fails identically on Windows.
fix_direction: Row is append-only history; repair the escape in a webhigh lane follow-up (double the backslash) or accept the row as lossy. This unit only made the D-015 test parse just the ISS-104 row.
